segments.name: Infrastructure and road construction
segments.description: Constructs and maintains roadways and related infrastructure for public and private customers across eight Sunbelt states.
segments.evidence: Management has determined that the Company functions as a single operating segment, and thus reports as a single reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: The company is paid by federal, state and local public agencies and private developers under fixed unit price, lump sum and design-build contracts for road construction and maintenance services and materials.
revenueModel.evidence: Our public customer contracts are primarily fixed unit price contracts.
